summary: Stunning Jesmond Apartment · Furnished · Available March 2024 · Modern, Tasteful Decor Throughout · New Kitchen · Prime Jesmond Location
description:
My Property Box are thrilled to welcome to the Lettings market this stunning two double bedroom, top floor apartment situated on St. Georges Terrace, Jesmond.

The property comprises communal entrance and stairs to first floor, private entrance with stairs leading to a split landing, open plan lounge-kitchen, master bedroom with modern en-suite shower room, second double bedroom and family bathroom. Tastefully decorated throughout, the apartment oozes a homely & upmarket feel. Benefitting from a new kitchen, the open plan lounge-kitchen provides an impressive entertaining space. Ideally situated in the heart of Jesmond, the leafy suburb offers an abundance of local amenities and transport links including West Jesmond Metro Station close by.

Available from March 2024, fully furnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
